@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .gpr-testimonials-section { padding: 56px 30px 44px; }
  .gpr-social-header { gap: 24px; }
  .gpr-social-cards { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  .gpr-social-card { min-height: 245px; }
}
@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .gpr-testimonials-section { padding: 44px 20px 36px; }
  .gpr-social-header { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 22px; margin-bottom: 22px; }
  .gpr-social-proof { max-width: 380px; padding: 16px 20px 13px; }
  .gpr-social-stat strong { font-size: 28px; }
  .gpr-social-cards {
    grid-template-columns: none;
    grid-auto-flow: column;
    grid-auto-columns: minmax(240px, 82%);
    gap: 12px;
    overflow-x: auto;
    overscroll-behavior-x: contain;
    scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
    scroll-padding-inline: 0;
    scrollbar-width: thin;
    scrollbar-color: #be9a5e transparent;
    padding-bottom: 12px;
  }
  .gpr-social-card { min-height: 275px; scroll-snap-align: start; }
  .gpr-social-footer { align-items: flex-start; margin-top: 16px; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .gpr-social-caption { display: none; }
  .gpr-social-swipe { display: inline; color: #53625b; font-size: 11px; line-height: 44px; }
  .gpr-social-follow { padding-inline: 16px; }
  .gpr-social-dialog { padding: 14px; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) and (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .gpr-social-card { transition: transform .25s ease, box-shadow .25s ease, border-color .25s ease; }
  .gpr-social-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); border-color: #be9a5e; box-shadow: 0 14px 30px -20px rgba(21, 47, 39, .35); }
  .gpr-social-follow { transition: background-color .2s ease; }
  .gpr-social-follow:hover { background: #eee5d2; }
  .gpr-social-close, .gpr-social-dialog .gpr-social-open-original { transition: background-color .2s ease, border-color .2s ease; }
  .gpr-social-close:hover, .gpr-social-dialog .gpr-social-open-original:hover { background: rgba(216, 189, 136, .12); border-color: #be9a5e; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  .gpr-social-dialog[open] { animation: gpr-social-popup-in .22s cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1); }
}
@keyframes gpr-social-popup-in {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px) scale(.98); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
}
@supports (animation-timeline: view()) {
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
    .gpr-social-ornament {
      animation: gpr-social-drift linear both;
      animation-timeline: view();
      animation-range: entry 0% exit 100%;
    }
  }
}
@keyframes gpr-social-drift {
  from { transform: translate(-12px, -25px) scale(.92); }
  to { transform: translate(12px, 35px) scale(1.08); }
}

    root.querySelector('.gpr-social-close').addEventListener('click', function () { dialog.close(); });
    dialog.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
      if (event.target !== dialog) return;
      var bounds = dialog.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (event.clientX < bounds.left || event.clientX > bounds.right || event.clientY < bounds.top || event.clientY > bounds.bottom) dialog.close();
    });
    dialog.addEventListener('close', function () {
      if (fitRequest) window.cancelAnimationFrame(fitRequest);
      fitRequest = null;
      currentFrame = null;
      player.replaceChildren();
      player.style.width = '';
      player.style.height = '';
      document.body.style.overflow = previousOverflow;
      if (opener && opener.isConnected) opener.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    });
  }
  var observer;
  var active = new Set();
  function stopMotion() {
    if (observer) observer.disconnect();
    active.forEach(function (animation) { animation.cancel(); });
    active.clear();
  }
  function startMotion() {
    if (preference.matches || !('IntersectionObserver' in window) || !Element.prototype.animate) return;
    observer = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
      var order = 0;
      entries.forEach(function (entry) {
        if (!entry.isIntersecting) return;
        observer.unobserve(entry.target);
        if (preference.matches || entry.target.dataset.socialRevealed) return;
        entry.target.dataset.socialRevealed = 'true';
        if (entry.target.contains(document.activeElement)) return;
        var animation = entry.target.animate([
          { opacity: 0, transform: 'translateY(20px)' },
          { opacity: 1, transform: 'translateY(0)' }
        ], { duration: 650, delay: (order++ % 4) * 85, easing: 'cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)', fill: 'backwards' });
        active.add(animation);
        animation.onfinish = animation.oncancel = function () { active.delete(animation); };
      });
    }, { threshold: .12 });
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-social-reveal]').forEach(function (element) {
      if (!element.dataset.socialRevealed) observer.observe(element);
    });
  }
  root.addEventListener('focusin', function (event) {
    active.forEach(function (animation) {
      if (animation.effect.target.contains(event.target)) animation.cancel();
    });
  });
  if (preference.addEventListener) preference.addEventListener('change', function () { stopMotion(); startMotion(); });
  startMotion();
})();
</script>
